response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count DESC) AS station_rank FROM station_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share FROM ranked WHERE station_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, observstation;
